name: io.github.ara-5/second-brain
title: Second Brain
description: Shared Graph-RAG memory for AI agents: markdown vault, wikilink recall, tasks, messaging.

environmentVariables.name: BRAIN_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Folder holding the markdown vault. Defaults to ~/.second-brain/vault when installed from npm.

environmentVariables.name: BRAIN_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the local API server the MCP server starts and talks to (default 3747).

environmentVariables.name: BRAIN_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key; when set the local API requires it as a Bearer token.
